notes: A new ▸ Campaign button at the top of the left rail tracks where we are in the war (Build-up → Ultimatum → Shock & Awe → Invasion → Insurgency) and houses all campaign phase actions: the 48-hour ultimatum, beginning Shock and Awe, launching the ground invasion (G-Day), and choosing the air campaign plan

The ✸ Fires menu and strike pickers are compressed and cleaned up: strikes, strike boxes, MSR overwatch and air patrols are called in by mission type (Tomahawk salvo, Heavy bomber strike, Carrier air strike, Precision air strike, Gunship mission, A-10 gun run, Hellfire strike, CAS orbit, ISR orbit, Refueling track) rather than picking individual ships or squadrons
